about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in the colorful and exciting world of the funfair? Explore 5 unique maps filled with hand-drawn scenes of Ferris wheels, carousels, game stalls, and more. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to bring this lively frenzy to life!

Each map captures the lively and joyful atmosphere of the funfair with detailed hand drawings. Can you find the cats hidden in this bustling world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Enjoy the vibrant colors and funfair energy!

✨ Features:

🎠 5 unique funfair maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed funfair radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
